_note: Cited price observations for cp_coke. Verbatim quotes only.
Rows 2 and 3 are the SAME fact reported by two brokers on consecutive days —
both are stored, because both were genuinely said and each refreshes
staleness, but the resolver must count the -7% ONCE. That is rule 2 in
packages/core/series.py, and this pair is the live test of it.
PERIOD MATTERS: these are QUARTERLY AVERAGE import prices, not spot. The
as_of is when it was reported; the value describes the quarter named in
`period`. A quarterly average moving into a daily bridge is coarse — it is
the right level of precision for a contracted input, not for a traded one.
